title: Instructional genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for INSTRUCTIONAL documents (textbooks, courseware, open educational resources, tutorial docs-sites). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to. Roles ground in lib/ontology/teaching_roles.py (the 6-value teaching_role enum) and the canonical-15 instruction-block framework (lib/ontology/framework_blocks.py, B01..B15). Publisher-specific marker strings that TRIGGER these roles live ONLY in Layer-3 lexicons (openstax_lexicon.json, generic_instructional_lexicon.json) — never here.
$comment: Roles map to lib/ontology/teaching_roles.py TEACHING_ROLES (introduce, elaborate, reinforce, assess, transfer, synthesize) via `maps_to_teaching_role` and to canonical framework blocks (lib/ontology/framework_blocks.py B01..B15) via `framework_block`. guided_practice is the de-publishered canonical name for the immediate-practice prompt (the co-occurrence practice_of derivation; the publisher-specific marker strings that trigger it live in the Layer-3 lexicons, not here). Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty (>=1 layer-1 kind).

x-roles.label: Worked example
x-roles.description: A fully-solved demonstration problem (label + stem + steps). The example's LABEL region anchors the unit; its body regions coagulate via the SemantiK unit-regroup.

x-roles.label: Solution
x-roles.description: The worked-out answer/steps immediately following a worked_example or exercise_item.

x-roles.label: Guided practice
x-roles.description: An immediate-practice prompt following a worked example (the de-publishered practice-prompt role). Canonical framework B08. Triggered by publisher/generic markers held in Layer-3 lexicons.

x-roles.label: Answer / answer-key item
x-roles.description: An answer-key entry keyed to an exercise_item (odd-answers, solutions appendix).

x-roles.label: Learning objectives
x-roles.description: An objectives block (a chapter/section's stated outcomes).

x-roles.label: Definition / callout box
x-roles.description: A set-off definition, note, or callout box (term-definition or an emphasized note).

x-roles.label: Summary
x-roles.description: A chapter/section summary that consolidates the preceding content.

x-roles.label: Review
x-roles.description: A review section (chapter review / review exercises heading + body) that reinforces prior material.

x-roles.label: Key terms / glossary
x-roles.description: A key-terms or glossary block (term + short definition list).
